name: v1.51.1
body:
### Bug Fixes

- detect multi-arch ingress-nginx [PR [#5179](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5179) @CAOShurong]
- keep the epoch when parsing RPM manifest packages [PR [#5201](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5201) @sueun-dev]
- correct Apache Derby group ID in purl generation [PR [#5090](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5090) @Ankush-Pathak]
- move image hardlink handling upstream during image indexing [PR [#5196](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5196) @wagoodman]
- keep epoch-pinned requirements in the SBOM [PR [#5161](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5161) @sueun-dev]
- Prevent unnecessary allocations when parsing compressed ELF sections [PR [#5187](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5187) @wagoodman]
- honor the io.ReaderAt contract in readerAtAdapter [PR [#5186](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5186) @wagoodman]
- Support grafana binary various version [Issue [#5059](https://github.com/anchore/syft/issues/5059)] [PR [#5213](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5213) @pujitha24]
- Excluded paths are still scanned and cause syft to crash [Issue [#3258](https://github.com/anchore/syft/issues/3258)]
- Dotnet: Incorrect relationship graph in case of using package locks [Issue [#5125](https://github.com/anchore/syft/issues/5125)] [PR [#5143](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5143) @pujitha24]
- Survive indexing not accessible files [Issue [#3286](https://github.com/anchore/syft/issues/3286)] [PR [#5170](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5170) @addielaruee]
- CPE target_sw not being set consistency for Rust crates [Issue [#3956](https://github.com/anchore/syft/issues/3956)] [PR [#5167](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5167) @Xenira]
- panic: nil pointer dereference in squashfs.(*File).Read when scanning snap (regression from 1.44.0) [Issue [#4989](https://github.com/anchore/syft/issues/4989)] [PR [#5119](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5119) @kzantow]
- golang remote license search attempts to resolve stdlib modules [Issue [#3149](https://github.com/anchore/syft/issues/3149)] [PR [#5192](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5192) @luantaraschi]

### Additional Changes

- gzip binary classifier reports false-positive GNU gzip from BusyBox multicall binary via applet symlink [Issue [#5171](https://github.com/anchore/syft/issues/5171)] [PR [#5202](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5202) @spiffcs]
- pnpm v5 lockfile: underscore peer-dep suffixes are not stripped from package versions [Issue [#5174](https://github.com/anchore/syft/issues/5174)] [PR [#5175](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5175) @codeAnqiang-ma]
- pnpm cataloger reads only the first YAML document: SBOM contains pnpm's own binaries and no project dependencies [Issue [#5168](https://github.com/anchore/syft/issues/5168)] [PR [#5188](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5188) @hamodywe]

### Dependencies

72 dependency changes (70 updated, 1 added, 1 removed). 3 vulnerabilities remediated.

**🟢 Remediated (3)**

- [GO-2026-5158](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-go/security/advisories/GHSA-5wrp-cwcj-q835) (Medium) — go.opentelemetry.io/otel
- [GO-2026-6179](https://go.dev/issue/80744) (High) — golang.org/x/mod
- [GO-2026-6180](https://go.dev/issue/80745) (High) — golang.org/x/mod
